description:
Cast Wingrattle Scarecrow by paying {3}.
Wingrattle Scarecrow enters the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Metallic Mimic.
Reaper King triggers, destroying Wingrattle Scarecrow.
Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, triggering its persist ability, returning it to the battlefield with no -1/-1 counters due to Metallic Mimic.
Repeat from step 3.
